records.metric_raw: Average Gross Sales / Median Gross Sales
records.notes: 22 outlets measured out of 23 total franchised stores open as of November 30, 2025. Excluded outlets opened for the first time during the past fiscal year or temporarily closed. 50% of stores met or exceeded the median gross sales. Data sourced from weekly sales reports provided by franchisees; not audited.

notes: Item 19 discloses gross sales (average and median) for all franchised outlets open during December 1, 2024 through November 30, 2025. Single cohort, two central-tendency metrics reported together. Pct_above_avg set to 32% (7 of 22 stores met or exceeded average). No min/max or percentile data disclosed.
